fields.description: Greenspoint is a gated townhouse neighbourhood in Emaar South, with three and four bedroom homes arranged in groups of four. Its outdoor spaces encourage an active routine: cycling paths, a looped jogging track, playgrounds and gardens sit alongside places to swim and gather. The homes pair contemporary façades with earthy colours and wood-inspired interiors.

overview: Greenspoint’s paths connect recreation spaces rather than treating them as isolated amenities. The brochure describes a cycling route continuing through three neighbouring communities, alongside a local jogging loop, gardens and a sports court. Emaar South’s golf, retail, education and wellness facilities form the broader setting; their availability and access terms should be checked separately.
research.locationNote: Greenspoint sits within Emaar South in Dubai South. Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai are key nearby destinations in the developer’s location material. Published driving times are indicative and will vary with the route and traffic.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises Greenspoint from AED 3,360,000. The figure is a starting headline, not a live unit quotation. Confirm the selected home, release and applicable charges before relying on it.
research.paymentNote: This is the February 2025 launch schedule: 10% at booking, seven 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Dates already passed remain historical; a new purchase requires its own current payment agreement.
research.handoverNote: The copied Emaar payment sheet targets March 2029 for estimated construction completion. Property Finder reports the same month. Neither replaces the contractual handover provisions.

facts.label: Launch composition
facts.value: The launch sheet identifies 196 homes: 98 with three bedrooms and 98 with four. These are launch totals, not available inventory.

facts.label: Plot and price context
facts.value: The launch sheet gives average plots of 1,882 sq ft for three bedroom homes and 3,236 sq ft for four bedroom homes. Historical starting prices were AED 3.36 million and AED 3.86 million respectively. A plot average is not the built-up area.

facts.label: Four bedroom arrangement
facts.value: Both Lana and Ada plans place a guest bedroom, living and dining spaces downstairs, with three bedrooms upstairs. Maid’s accommodation, laundry and a carport are labelled. End homes and internal three bedroom homes occupy different positions within each four-home block.

facts.label: How areas are measured
facts.value: The plan’s total combines suite, garage and balcony/terrace areas. It should not be compared directly with internal living space or plot size.
